r0.why: Rate parameter lambda>0 [4], support [0,inf) [5], notation [6], Poisson point processes and other contexts [1].

r1.why: Not the same as exponential families, which include it plus normal, binomial, gamma, Poisson [2][3].

r2.why: Mean 1/lambda [8], phone-call example [9], variance and SD equals mean [10].

r3.why: Memoryless relation and waiting-time reading [11][12], 30/10 second example [13], only exp and geometric [14], constant failure rate [15].

r4.why: Largest differential entropy on [0,inf) with mean mu, lambda=1/mu [16][17].

r5.why: Scaling [18], equal-rate sum Erlang shape 2 special case of gamma [24], n-sum Gamma(n,lambda) [25], Exp=Gamma(1)=Erlang(1) [43].
